item.title: Can AI Outrun America’s Deficit Problem?
item.description: [Bloomberg] National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett argues that the economic benefits of AI may be greater than current data show, comparing today’s dynamics with the early internet era, when improvements in computing were difficult to capture in official statistics. He acknowledges that bringing the federal deficit to 3% of GDP will require more attention. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Pam Bondi’s Secret DOJ Email Address Revealed
item.description:
[Bloomberg] A FOIA request has uncovered another little-known feature of life at the top of the Justice Department: attorneys general have used alternate email addresses to conduct government business for over a decade. This time around, Bloomberg News Senior Investigative Reporter Jason Leopold obtained the alias used by former Attorney General Pam Bondi.
The discovery raises broader questions about government transparency and access to public records. Leopold explains how alternate email addresses can make FOIA searches more difficult when requesters don’t know which accounts officials used to conduct government business -- and how revealing those aliases can help journalists locate records that might otherwise be missed. He speaks with Bloomberg Businessweek Daily hosts Carol Massar and Alexis Christoforous. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: EM Assets Find Relief as US Jobs Data Eases Rate Fears
item.description: [Bloomberg] An index tracking emerging-market currencies climbed to a session high after weaker-than-expected US jobs data prompted traders to scale back bets on another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday. The figure missed all estimates in a Bloomberg survey of economists. For more, we speak with Anisha Goodly, Fixed Income Managing Director at TCW. (Source: Bloomberg)
